tagline: Generate secure QR codes for any Odoo record with scan tracking and print options
problem: Most QR solutions are limited to one document type and do not provide reusable tracking.
solution: Universal QR Generator adds one secure framework for token routing, scan logs, model-level configuration, and printable QR output across Odoo apps.
benefits: Universal model support through base inheritance
Secure token endpoint with expiration handling
Bulk ZIP export for operations teams
Native report integration for core business documents

features.title: Universal mixin
features.text: QR fields and actions are available on all models through rn.qr.mixin.

features.title: Scan analytics
features.text: Track token, timestamp, source, and network metadata in scan logs.

features.title: Templates and model config
features.text: Configure defaults and per-model behavior from backend menus.

features.title: Reports and export
features.text: Print labels, A4 sheets, and download QR batches as ZIP.

seo_keywords: Odoo 19, Odoo Community, universal qr, qr generator, qr scan tracking
